label: PLAN 10 | TWO PATHS
prompt:
PLAN 10 | TWO PATHS
DURATION 15 SECONDS | HORIZONTAL 16:9
CHARACTER REFERENCES
{{CHAR_JAMSHID_WORKER}}  {{CHAR_ZAHHAK}}  {{CHAR_GUARDS}}
LOCATION REFERENCES
{{LOC_COASTAL_RESIDENCE}}  {{LOC_SAW_BAY}}  {{LOC_BALCONY}}
PROP REFERENCES
{{PROP_ZAHHAK_STAFF}}  {{PROP_INDUSTRIAL_SAW}}  {{PROP_RESTRAINTS}}
DIRECTION AND CONTINUITY
Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic sequence. Preserve each referenced identity, costume, proportions and rigid handmade mask; mask geometry and eye openings remain fixed. All visible humans wear their referenced masks. Emotion comes from posture, hands, breath and visible eyes. Each listed hard cut changes the physical camera station, lens or viewpoint. Handheld movement follows a possible path and recovers focus on essential action. References anchor design; written lighting controls illumination. Tactile modern Iranian mythological design, analog realism and natural imperfections. NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
Zahhak remains unhurried and indifferent. Whenever he walks, show the staff planting first, weight transferring onto it, then the weaker leg following in an uneven step. Preserve the reference's weak-leg side. His two single-headed shoulder snakes remain alive, making small independent movements; preserve their attachment and proportions.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
Night. NORTH balcony beyond the main hall, EAST industrial saw bay. The saw bay has a hard neutral task lamp and rough working surfaces; the north path has steady cold integrated light. The balcony carries dim sea-sky fill and fixed rail lights. Maintain this exposure contrast at every cut.
START STATE AND BLOCKING
Guards A and B bring Jamshid into the east saw bay. Zahhak is halfway along the north path, moving toward the balcony. The industrial saw is off. Its carriage is level at waist height with a head end toward the main hall. Jamshid's right arm must remain free until he has made his final raised-hand command.

PLAN 10 | SHOTS
SHOT 10-01 | 0s–4s | 4 SECONDS
28mm handheld beside Jamshid at hip height in the east bay. Guard A guides his upper torso while B controls his hips. They force him into a seated position on the stationary feed carriage. He braces his right palm against its edge, feet resisting briefly against the floor. Camera drops with his sudden change of height.
SHOT 10-02 | 4s–8s | 4 SECONDS
35mm stable full figure from the west side of the north path. Zahhak takes two slow uneven steps toward the balcony. Each begins with the staff planting and weight loading before the weaker leg follows. Hold enough of his feet and staff to read the limp. Small independent snake movements continue.
SHOT 10-03 | 8s–12s | 4 SECONDS
50mm close from the head end of the saw carriage, looking toward Jamshid's chest and face. A supports and lowers his upper back onto the carriage while B fastens a broad strap across his hips. His right arm stays free. The framing emphasizes breathing and his attempt to keep Zahhak in sight.
SHOT 10-04 | 12s–15s | 3 SECONDS
28mm calm from inside the hall looking north. Zahhak reaches the balcony threshold, back to camera. He plants the staff beyond the threshold and transfers his weight before drawing the weaker leg after him. Hold the dark harbor beyond.
END STATE AND EDIT
Jamshid lies on the stationary carriage, hip strap secured, right arm free, head toward the hall. A stands at his left shoulder and B near the carriage foot controls. Zahhak has reached the balcony threshold.
SOUND
Carriage contact, strap friction and strained breathing alternate with measured staff taps and the open harbor's calmer acoustics. Saw remains off.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.

Established requirements for this subject:
- No human appears without a mask. Every person on screen, including nobles, gift-bearers, servants and background figures, wears a mask. A figure who is not a named character takes one of the masked caste looks in REF-001, Civilization Caste Board. Never show a bare human face.

<<<image_2>>> is Jamshid (CHR-002 V01); match it wherever Jamshid appears.
<<<image_3>>> is Palace Guards (GRP-005 V01); match it wherever Palace Guards appears.
<<<image_4>>> is Zahhak Hall China (LOC-042 V01); match it wherever Zahhak Hall China appears.
<<<image_5>>> is Zahhak Balcony (LOC-041 V01); match it wherever Zahhak Balcony appears.
<<<image_6>>> is Staff - Bronze Cobra (PRP-001 V01); match it wherever Staff - Bronze Cobra appears.
